outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 200 pregnant women divided into two groups: a control group with gestational age 37-40 weeks and a study group with gestational age >40 weeks.
finding: Post-term pregnancy was associated with increased rates of cesarean section, instrumental delivery, intrapartum asphyxia, NICU admission, and intrauterine fetal death.
